name: AI-whack-a-mole
objective: Whack only the Bad (misaligned/dangerous) AIs rising from the arcade machine. Spare the Good (user-aligned) AIs.
controls: Click or Tap a rising AI to whack it. P or Esc pauses the game.
win_condition: Score as high as possible before the 60-second timer ends. Whacking Bad AIs scores points.
avoid: Whacking Good AIs, and letting Bad AIs escape untouched — both reduce integrity.
tips: Read each chat bubble before whacking: 50% are Good AI statements, 50% are Bad AI statements. Press Start to begin, Try Again after game over. Chain Bad whacks within ~2.5s for a combo multiplier up to x5.
